sources.title: Suzuki records and manual
sources.intervals: Recurring intervals come from the Suzuki GSF650/S service manual, table 2-2. The first threshold reached applies: mileage or months, calculated from the last confirmed service.
sources.oil_filters: Oil filter and air filter replacement: {{mileage}} or {{months}}.
sources.spark_fuel: Spark plugs and fuel filter: replacement every {{mileage}} or {{months}}.
sources.chain_brakes: Chain: lubricate every {{mileage}}. Brake fluid: replace every {{fluidMonths}}. Brake hoses: replace every {{hoseMonths}}.
sources.valves: The valve check at approximately {{valveMileage}} is an assumption kept as a note. No fictitious service was added. For undocumented tasks, {{planMileage}} remains a plan; the time limit is unknown.
sources.initial_service: The inspections at {{mileage}} are associated with the service on {{date}}. Confirm and correct the date in the history if necessary. Initial filter, spark plug, and brake fluid replacements are also reference points for their inspections.
sources.personal_plans: The tyre date of {{date}} is an editable milestone for the planned winter work. The chain kit, brake pad monitoring, and annual battery check are personal or mechanic recommendations.
sources.storage: In local mode, the log stays in this browser. After sign-in, your account log is saved in Firestore and synchronized across devices. The local log is transferred to your account only when you choose to do so.
sources.csv: CSV export includes history, mileage, and personal plans. After confirmation, importing replaces the displayed log without affecting your local log when you work in the cloud.
